_note: Events picked because they involve strangers, shared effort, or awe: the opposite of the cynic's retreat. Tags: connect (meet people), serve (help out), play (do something together), awe (feel small in a good way, including meditation). Sources include Funcheap, KQED, SF Public Library (sfpl.org/events), Humanitix, SF Zen Center (sfzc.org/calendar), Grace Cathedral, and organizers. Confirm details with organizers before going.
